definition.title: The Long Shot
definition.briefing: A wounded Ironjaw commander guards the quarry. Defeat him with Bryn and the escort while the cannon waits, then recover and equip his dropped artifact. Emplace the cannon on the western firing shelf to outrange and destroy the marked tower.
definition.successText: Bryn recovers the Ironjaw commander's artifact and the tower falls from the prepared shelf. The quarry workers reach the Mountain Keep before the warband returns.
definition.failureText: Bryn or the cannon is lost. Reset and prepare the firing position before engaging the tower.

definition.title: Seventy Seconds at Deep Gate
definition.briefing: The quarry crew is inside. Emplace Bryn's line at the narrow Deep Gate and hold the Mountain Keep for seventy-five seconds. Sena has repair timber and a two-soldier reserve.
definition.successText: Sena closes the Deep Gate. Bryn can escort the surveyor through the mines or scout the warband's northern works.
definition.failureText: The Mountain Keep or Bryn falls while the gate is open. Reset the defensive line.

objectives.text: Hold the fortress for 75 seconds. The reinforcement allowance is 2; the listed waves are finite.
Keep Bryn Deepforge alive during the defense.

definition.title: The Surveyor's Passage
definition.briefing: Surveyor Sena knows the route to the stolen pump. Escort her around the flooded galleries. Pack up emplacement before moving, then prepare again when the dead emerge at each crossing.
definition.successText: Sena marks the dry route to the pump chamber. Bryn can confront the Grave Warden without crossing its flooded gun line.
definition.failureText: Sena or Bryn is lost in the galleries. Reset and move the escort with the surveyor.

objectives.text: Escort convoy through all 3 checkpoints. Keep troops within seven tiles so the convoy advances.
Keep Bryn Deepforge alive until the convoy arrives.

definition.title: The Grave Warden's Pump
definition.briefing: The Grave Warden has occupied the pump chamber. Emplace Bryn's troops on dry ground, interrupt pressure bursts with the cannons, and pack up when a warning circle covers the firing shelf.
definition.successText: The pump runs again and the mines drain. Bryn leaves Sena in charge of the works, with a firing shelf prepared at every entrance.
definition.failureText: Bryn falls before the pump is recovered. The mines remain flooded under the Warden.

objectives.text: Defeat Grave Warden. Survive all three phases and move out of a warning circle or interrupt it with concentrated fire.
Dodge or interrupt at least one telegraphed attack.
